column1: # PSG PDF's own interface strings in zh-hans, appended to the craft-i18n catalog at build time

column2: No signature font can draw “{char}”. Use other letters, or draw or import your signature.
column3: 无法用任何签名字体绘制“{char}”。请换用其他文字，或手写签名、导入签名图片。
